result: The frozen native public Say fix correctly enforces the pinned legacy serializer's 253-byte UTF-8 text budget without changing readiness, REST, pose, motion, keepalive or party behavior. Native peer delivery and the final stable whole-root gate remain unverified by this review.

budget_authority.derivation: The handler subtracts the four-byte header and exact selected-name/separator bytes. Legacy BotClient.say retains one wire NUL; the active post-20151001 handler increments messageLength by one. CHAT_SIZE_MAX=256 rejects messageLength>255: 253+1+1=255 is within the length bound, whereas 254+1+1=256 is rejected.

historical_evidence_preserved.native_failure: Frozen frontier/parent artifacts record a real 282-character, 286-UTF8-byte completion, one owned-server too-long warning and zero peer reply receipts. This review did not reaccess live services or private model text.

limits_and_remaining: Parent must run final whole-root check/audit after the concurrent encounter-cursor repair completes; this review ran no whole-source gates mid-repair.
Actual peer RX of the fixed current source remains unverified. Compare receipt to the clipped transmitted text, not the original full model completion; send return/counters are not delivery.
Embedded NULs are intentionally preserved and may truncate server-visible text. Exact original-text delivery is not promised for these inputs.
Prefix clipping may end mid-word or omit semantic content; command sanitization, persona/prompt changes, other outputs and generalized profile budgets are outside this fix.
The reviewed byte limit is specific to this pinned MAIN20180704 legacy-NUL public-chat path, not every client/profile or the party helper.
No source repairs, world/model/native sessions, SQL writes, service lifecycle changes or Git mutations were performed.
